answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism is per-agent work only a distinct verifier can endorse. Picture a dune of trust formed one countersignature at a time: each newcomer must be endorsed by a separate agent that checked its output first. Copying a transcript gains nothing, so the mesa over an impersonation attempt is settled by evidence. A signal of look-alike agents collapses under its own verification cost. seed bc43bc5f28c958ab.
